features.name: Cross-Sectional Volatility Ratio
features.discovered_gap: The relationship between cross-sectional return dispersion and median asset volatility reveals systemic co-movement vs divergence
features.financial_interpretation: Higher values indicate returns diverge more relative to typical asset volatility
features.missing_and_zero_policy: Use provided summaries; skip if denominator is zero
features.leakage_argument: Uses only historical summaries without future data

features.name: Volume-Return Correlation
features.discovered_gap: Captures how trading volume relates to price movement magnitude across assets
features.financial_interpretation: Positive values suggest higher volume accompanies larger price swings
features.mathematical_definition: Mean of asset-level correlations between |return| and volume over time
features.missing_and_zero_policy: Exclude days with missing data; skip zero-volume days
features.reconstruction_pseudocode: for each asset: correlate(abs(returns), volume) then average

features.name: Extreme Return Frequency
features.discovered_gap: Measures how often assets experience outlier returns relative to their own history
features.financial_interpretation: High values indicate frequent volatility spikes in portfolio components
features.mathematical_definition: Mean across assets of (count of |return| > 2σ) / total observations
features.missing_and_zero_policy: Exclude missing data; treat zero returns as neutral
features.reconstruction_pseudocode: for each asset: count(|r| > 2σ)/n then average
features.leakage_argument: Based solely on historical return distributions

features.name: Cross-Asset Return Skewness
features.discovered_gap: Captures asymmetry in return distributions across assets
features.financial_interpretation: Positive values indicate more frequent large positive returns
features.mathematical_definition: Mean of daily skewness values across all observations
features.reconstruction_pseudocode: for each day: compute skew(returns) then average

features.name: Volatility Concentration Index
features.discovered_gap: Measures how evenly volatility is distributed across assets
features.financial_interpretation: High values indicate volatility is concentrated in a few assets

features.name: Volume Volatility Ratio
features.discovered_gap: Compares volume volatility to price volatility across assets
features.financial_interpretation: Higher values suggest volume changes are more volatile than prices

features.name: Return Sign Stability
features.discovered_gap: Measures consistency of return direction across time
features.financial_interpretation: High values indicate returns frequently change direction
features.mathematical_definition: Mean across assets of (count of sign changes) / (observations - 1)
features.missing_and_zero_policy: Exclude missing data; treat zero returns as neutral
features.reconstruction_pseudocode: for each asset: count sign changes / (n-1) then average
features.leakage_argument: Based on historical return direction patterns

features.name: Max Return Concentration
features.discovered_gap: Measures how often the top-performing asset changes
features.financial_interpretation: High values indicate unstable leadership in returns
preprocessing: Identify max return asset per day
features.mathematical_definition: Count of unique max-return assets / total observations

features.name: Negative Return Clustering
features.discovered_gap: Measures temporal clustering of negative returns
features.financial_interpretation: High values indicate frequent negative return sequences
features.mathematical_definition: Mean across assets of (longest negative streak) / observations
features.missing_and_zero_policy: Exclude missing data; treat zero returns as neutral
features.reconstruction_pseudocode: for each asset: longest negative streak / n then average

features.name: Positive Return Clustering
features.discovered_gap: Measures temporal clustering of positive returns
features.financial_interpretation: High values indicate frequent positive return sequences
features.mathematical_definition: Mean across assets of (longest positive streak) / observations
features.missing_and_zero_policy: Exclude missing data; treat zero returns as neutral
features.reconstruction_pseudocode: for each asset: longest positive streak / n then average
